turns.assessment: The only anomaly is a flat reported value; there is no optical, quality, traffic, or alarm symptom. All other metrics on trx.och117.z, the opposite endpoint, channel monitors, and amplifiers also show no change, which argues strongly against a physical path fault. A card failure would normally suppress valid monitoring and cause traffic/signal-loss evidence, not leave an apparently valid constant reading, so the documented modes do not explain this well; a telemetry/reporting issue or simply stable power is more likely.

proposals.rationale: A local card fault could affect receiver telemetry, but the expected unit-down, traffic loss, silent/invalid monitoring, and far-end channel impact are absent.

This is the documented receiver-local fault, but it should produce a receiver penalty or errors; pre-FEC BER, OSNR, and other receiver metrics show no change, and a frozen power reading is not its documented effect.

score.why: cause flagged as unconsidered and absent
